question: According to the WHO 2016 model of antenatal care, what is the recommended minimum number of contacts between a pregnant woman and a health-care provider during a normal pregnancy?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: 4 visits was the older WHO focused ANC model (2002). The 2016 model increased this to a minimum of 8 contacts.
6 is not the WHO 2016 recommendation. The 2016 positive ANC model recommends a minimum of 8 contacts.
Correct. The WHO 2016 model recommends a minimum of 8 contacts, replacing the earlier 4-visit focused ANC model.
12 contacts exceeds the minimum recommendation. WHO 2016 sets the minimum at 8 contacts for a normal pregnancy.

overallFeedback.feedback: Review the WHO 2016 ANC model. The minimum of 8 contacts was a significant upward revision from the prior 4-visit model.
Well done. WHO 2016 recommends ≥8 ANC contacts — remember this replaces the older 4-visit focused ANC model.
